scope: Local API smoke only; no authentication token, database writes, migrations, or Cloud calls

before_temporary_server_start.interpretation: No service was listening at the configured local API address during the initial check

notes: Unauthenticated 401 responses confirm routes are mounted and reachable; they do not verify a signed-in Payroll response.
The health endpoint reports environment=production as a source constant; it is not evidence of the connected database environment.
A separate no-reload Uvicorn invocation selected ProactorEventLoop and failed async psycopg DB access; the project's reload-mode launch selected a compatible loop and passed the health DB check.
The temporary API process was stopped after the smoke checks.
